title: The cancel dialog and what the API does
caption: bookings/[bookingId]/cancel-dialog.tsx, action-rules.ts cancelPlanOf; the step is the API's cancellationMode (console.bookings.get), decided in storefront_settings.time_zone. FIX-W35/36/37-OTA.

states.label: Dialog open
states.detail: Reason category, reason, money, "E-mail the cancellation to the traveller" (on).

states.label: Release
states.detail: Nothing ticketed: Amadeus DELETE releases the seats. Refund modes of the payment (none / full / amount).

states.label: Void
states.detail: Every ticket issued today in the OTA's time zone: DELETE voids them. Airline card: only "No refund from the console".

states.label: Request to the airline
states.detail: A ticket of an earlier day: no DELETE, no refund choice (`refund.mode = none`), no money moves.

states.label: Cancellation requested
states.detail: Booking unchanged with a pending staff cancellation, `booking.cancellation_requested` e-mail; Cancel hidden afterwards (canCancel `pending`). Finish with the airline, then Resync, then Refund.

states.label: refund_not_available
states.detail: The page showed release/void but the API found an older ticket: the dialog switches to the request form with a new key.
